english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an individual or organization that makes goods or provides services.
This is the all-purpose choice for the person or company responsible for making goods.
Use 生產商 for the manufacturer or company that made the product, rather than its brand.

examples.english: This producer specializes in making eco-friendly cleaning products.
examples.traditional: 呢間生產商專門生產環保清潔用品。
